## Cyberdeck.favoriteMod() method

Sets a mod to be marked as "favorite" (or removes the favorite status from a mod, if specified.)

Favorited mods cannot be recycled.

**Signature:**

```typescript
favoriteMod(modId: string, favorite?: boolean): void;
```
